Puñjarāja
of Śrīmālā family of Malabar; settled a. Malwa; son of Jīvana an. Maku, was minister of Giasudin Khilji (A. D. 1469-1500).
See S. K. Belvalkar, Systems of Sanskrit Grammar p.. 96-97; Y. Mimamsak, Sam3skṛta Vyākaraṇ Śāstra kā Itihās I. p. 572.
--Dhvanipradīpa. Bhr. p. 12.
Q. in a.'s Śiśuprabodhālaṅkāra.
See J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni. XII. i. p. 3.
--Śiśuprabodhālaṅkāra.
Pt.. J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni. XII. i. p. 1 ff.
--C. on Sārasvataprakriyā of Anubhūtisvarūpa. Baroda 63 (b & c). IO. 801-02.

Puñjarāja
pupil of Mādhava; patronised by King Śambhu of Nandidvāra; born in 1662-63 A. D.
--Śambhuhorāprakāśa. jy. Baroda II. 9295. BBRAS. 374. Bomb. Uni. 504. Mithilā III. 361. Rep. Hpr. 1901-06, p. 6. Trav. Uni. 1283. [Page108-a.
